mode.description: Which mode to decode: FT8 (15 s slots), FT4 (7.5 s slots) or WSPR (2 min slots).

depth.description: Decoder search depth, 1 (fast) to 3 (finds the most, needs the most CPU). Default 2.

dial_hz.description: Dial frequency in Hz that the audio offsets are added to for the absolute frequency of a signal. Default: the frequency the decoder was started on.
